verdict.rationale: Extend references a web-based "Studio" for iterating on processors (extend-docs-18, extend-docs-40) which implies a no-code interface for testing parse/extract, but no evidence describes a drag-and-drop upload flow or explicitly shows results appearing before any code is written.
